title: Edit draft
readOnly: This version is published, so it can no longer change. Create a new draft to make changes.
unsupported: This draft has a shape the chapter editor cannot show. Edit the whole file instead.
intro: Change titles, order, which lessons are required and the reading text. Checks, visuals and activities stay as they are; change them in the whole file. Nothing reaches learners until this draft is reviewed and published.
problems.title: Fix these before saving
problem.chapter_empty: Chapter “{name}” needs at least one lesson.
problem.lesson_title: A lesson in this draft needs a title.
problem.lesson_objective: Lesson “{name}” needs at least one learning objective.
problem.lesson_empty: Lesson “{name}” needs at least one section.
problem.course_empty: The course needs at least one chapter.
result.invalid: The draft cannot be saved yet
result.identity: This file is for a different course or version than this draft. Keep the course id and version unchanged.
result.summary: {chapters, plural, one {# chapter} two {# chapters} other {# chapters}}, {lessons, plural, one {# lesson} two {# lessons} other {# lessons}} and {checks, plural, one {# check} two {# checks} other {# checks}}.
result.identical: Nothing differs from the version learners start on now.
result.changes: {count, plural, one {# change} two {# changes} other {# changes}} from the version learners start on now.
result.runtime: This server cannot run the draft yet
result.runtimeBody: You can save it, but publishing will be refused until the missing part is installed. Ask the person who runs the server.
issue.SCHEMA: A required value is missing or has the wrong form.
issue.MISSING_REFERENCE: This points to something the course does not define.
issue.DUPLICATE_ID: Two parts share the same id.
issue.PREREQUISITE_CYCLE: Objectives depend on each other in a circle.
issue.OPTIONAL_ONLY_OBJECTIVE: An objective is taught only in optional lessons.
issue.UNCOVERED_GATE_OBJECTIVE: A checkpoint names an objective none of its checks covers.
issue.GATE_SCOPE_MISMATCH: A checkpoint does not match the objectives of its lesson.
issue.UNBOUNDED_POLICY: The learning policy needs a time limit.
